protocol.fit: Only ranks 68–71 may contribute sparse structure, dense depth, mesh geometry or texture
protocol.holdout: Reserve ranks 67 and 72 from all surface fitting, densification and texture. Pose-only localization against frozen geometry requires separately recorded correspondences; evaluate remaining image pixels after camera estimation.
protocol.independence: Adjacent views from the same capture sequence and photographer. They are unseen fitting inputs, with correlated capture conditions; they supply no independent capture-family or participant recognition evidence.
protocol.location: All six declared camera positions remain west of approved route edge 1
protocol.limits: Source metadata establishes rights and declared camera properties. Visible overlap, pose recovery, surface fidelity, metric scale and ground require separate measurements.
